basic_details.job_title: ANGRAU Research Associate (Cotton and Pulses Scheme) Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: Acharya N.G. Ranga Agricultural University (ANGRAU) will hold a walk-in interview on 9 November 2026 at 1:00 P.M. at the Regional Agricultural Research Station (RARS), Lam, Guntur. The interview was first scheduled for 17 October 2026 and has been rescheduled for administrative reasons. It fills 2 temporary posts of Research Associate (RA) under the Cotton and Pulses Scheme (Non Plan), with pay of Rs.61,000/- + HRA per month (for M.Sc.(Ag.)) and Rs.67,000/- + HRA per month (for Ph.D.).

age_limit.details: The age limit is not exceeding 40 years for men and 45 years for women. Age relaxation is as per Government norms for SC / ST candidates. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age.

content_sections.heading: About the Regional Agricultural Research Station, Lam
content_sections.text: The Regional Agricultural Research Station, Lam, Guntur is a research station of Acharya N.G. Ranga Agricultural University. These Research Associate posts are under the station's Cotton and Pulses Scheme (Non Plan). The notice is signed by the Associate Director of Research and dated 5 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: There are 2 posts of Research Associate (RA). The post is purely temporary, for 11 months from the date of joining. Candidates must meet one of the following educational qualifications: Doctoral Degree/ Ph.D in Genetics & Plant Breeding, or Master's degree in Genetics & Plant Breeding with 4/5 years of Bachelor's Degree having 1st division or equivalent overall grade point average with at least 3 years of respective teaching/research experience as evidenced from Fellowship/Associateship/Training/Other engagements, Published one research paper in Science Citation Index (SCI)/NAAS rated (>4.0) Journal. Candidates having a Post-graduate degree in Basic Sciences with 3 years Bachelor's degree and 2 years Master's degree should have NET qualification. All the relevant degrees should be completed in ICAR accredited Universities/Colleges. The age limit is not exceeding 40 years for men and 45 years for women. Age relaxation is as per Government norms for SC / ST candidates. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age. HRA is paid on top of the pay, as per the existing state Govt. rates applicable in various places/locations. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: ANGRAU Research Associate (RA) Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists the work under the two parts of the scheme: Cotton: To conduct cotton field experiments, handling of BG II segregating populations, knowledge on molecular works, collection of the samples for ELISA, running of ELISA and PCRs for DNA finger printing, recording the data at lab & Field and analysis of the data using different software. Pulses: Execution of Technical support for implementing the technical programme, breeder seed production of MULLaRP Scheme.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Bio-data Two sets of Xerox copies of educational qualifications and other documents, if any All original certificates, with a duplicate copy of the same, and other relevant documents An application on plain paper giving bio-data and the name and address of two references A latest passport size photograph affixed on the application Attested photocopies of the supporting documents No objection certificate, if employed The plain-paper application and its enclosures are submitted to the office at the time of interview.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates attend the walk-in interview directly at RARS, Lam on 9 November 2026 at 1:00 P.M. with the documents above. Candidates are interviewed by a selection committee, and the decision of the selection committee is final and binding in all aspects.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The interview originally set for 17.10.2026 now takes place on 09.11.2026; only the new date applies. This post is purely temporary. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview. Employed candidates must submit a no objection certificate.

faq.question: Q1. When is the ANGRAU Research Associate walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 9 November 2026 at 1:00 P.M. at RARS, Lam, Guntur. It was rescheduled from 17 October 2026 for administrative reasons.

faq.question: Q2. How many Research Associate posts are there?
faq.answer: There are 2 (Two) posts of Research Associate (RA) under the Cotton and Pulses Scheme (Non Plan).

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the ANGRAU Research Associate post?
faq.answer: A Doctoral Degree/Ph.D in Genetics & Plant Breeding, or a Master's degree in Genetics & Plant Breeding with the Bachelor's, experience and publication conditions given in the notice. All relevant degrees must be from ICAR accredited Universities/Colleges.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Not exceeding 40 years for men and 45 years for women, with age relaxation as per Government norms for SC / ST candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of an ANGRAU Research Associate?
faq.answer: Rs.61,000/- + HRA per month for M.Sc.(Ag.) and Rs.67,000/- + HRA per month for Ph.D.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the salary?
faq.answer: Yes. HRA is given as per the existing state Govt. rates applicable in various places/locations, in addition to the monthly pay.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I bring to the walk-in?
faq.answer: Bio-data, two sets of Xerox copies of certificates with originals, a plain-paper application with two references and a passport size photograph, attested photocopies, and a no objection certificate if employed.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Candidates are selected through the walk-in interview, and the decision of the selection committee is final and binding in all aspects.

faq.question: Q9. Is the Research Associate post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The post is purely temporary, for 11 months from the date of joining.

faq.question: Q10. Is TA/DA given for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA is admissible.
